title: Peaceful Queens on a Damaged Board
statement:
Place `n` queens on an `n x n` chessboard so that no two queens attack each other: no two share a row, a column or a diagonal. Some squares are damaged and no queen may stand on them. Damaged squares do not block attacks. Count the valid placements.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `k`, the number of damaged squares. Each of the next `k` lines contains the row and column (0-indexed) of one damaged square.

## Output
Print the number of valid placements.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 11`
- `0 <= k <= n * n`, all damaged squares are different
